hero.title: Cookie policy
hero.text: A short, plain-language explanation of the cookies used on this website.

body:
## The short version

**Visitors to this website are not tracked.** The public pages of assert.gr do not set advertising, analytics or social-media cookies, and our fonts and images are served from our own server rather than third parties.

## Strictly necessary cookies

| Cookie | Purpose | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | Keeps authorised editors signed in to the content management area. It is only set after logging in to the admin area. | Up to 8 hours |

Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent under the ePrivacy Directive and Greek Law 3471/2006.

## Managing cookies

You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings at any time. Blocking cookies will not affect your ability to browse the public website.

## Changes

If we introduce any new cookies — for example, privacy-friendly analytics — we will update this page and, where required, ask for your consent first.

Questions? Email [info@assert.gr](mailto:info@assert.gr).
